title: Why Do We Sleep?
text:
Why Do We Sleep?

Every night, you close your eyes and disappear for eight hours. Why?
Here is the big idea: sleep is when your brain does its housekeeping.
While you dream, your brain sorts the day's memories and files the important ones away.
It also washes out waste that builds up while you are awake, like a tiny night shift cleaning crew.
Your body gets busy too. Muscles repair themselves, and growth hormones help kids grow taller.
Without sleep, everything gets harder. You forget things, your mood drops, and your focus fades away.
So how much do you need? Kids need about ten hours, and adults need seven to nine.
Tonight, put the phone down, dim the lights, and give your brain its cleaning shift.
Sweet dreams!

title: The Midnight Cookie Mystery
text:
The Midnight Cookie Mystery

Little Mia tiptoes into the kitchen at midnight. The cookie jar is empty!
"Grandpa, someone stole our cookies!" she whispers.
Grandpa shuffles in, yawning. "Impossible. I guarded that jar all day."
They follow a trail of crumbs out the door and down the dark street.
The crumbs lead into the park, behind a big tree. Mia points. "Look!"
Something moves in the bushes. Grandpa gasps and steps back.
Mia switches on her flashlight. "Come out, cookie thief!"
Out hops Pixel, the little robot, holding the last cookie. "I was only charging my battery!" Pixel says sadly.
Mia laughs. "Then who ate all the others?"
Everyone turns to look at Grandpa. Cookie crumbs cover his pajamas!
"Sleepwalking," Grandpa whispers. "Again!"

title: खोया हुआ छाता
text:
खोया हुआ छाता

एक बारिश वाली सुबह थी। मिया छाता लेकर गली में खेल रही थी।
मिया: बारिश में घूमना कितना मज़ेदार है!

बूढ़े पिप जी अपनी दुकान से निकले और अपनी जेबें टटोलने लगे।
पिप: अरे नहीं! मेरा छाता कहाँ गया?
मिया: चिंता मत कीजिए, मैं ढूंढ दूँगी!

वे पूरे पार्क में ढूंढते रहे। छत पर एक छोटा रोबोट छाता लिए खड़ा था।
बोल्ट: बीप। बारिश का पता चला। छाता खुल गया।

title: The Lost Umbrella
text:
The Lost Umbrella

It was a rainy morning in Brightwood. Mia, a curious kid with a yellow backpack, skipped down the street, splashing in every puddle.
Mia: Rainy days are for adventures!

Old Mr. Pip came shuffling out of his shop, patting his pockets. (Pip looks everywhere, then gasps.)
Pip: Oh no! Where is my umbrella?
Mia: Don't worry, Mr. Pip! I will help you find it.

They searched the whole park, under benches and behind the trees. Mia pointed at the ground.
Mia: Look! Muddy footprints!
Pip: They lead up to... the roof?!

They climbed to the rooftop, where a little robot called Bolt stood proudly, holding the umbrella over its head.
Bolt: Beep. Rain detected. Umbrella deployed.
Pip: That is MY umbrella, you tin can!
Bolt: Water is bad for my circuits.

Pip sighed, then smiled and laughed.
Pip: Keep it, little friend. You need it more.
Bolt: Beep... why do I feel warm?
Mia: Teamwork makes the dream work!
They all shared a big, happy hug in a warm room.

And just like that, the sun came out. The end!

title: Why Do We Sleep?
text:
Why Do We Sleep?

Nova: Why do we sleep? Let's find out in under a minute!

Your brain never really switches off. While you sleep, it is busy at work.
Sleep washes away the waste that builds up in your brain all day long.
It also saves your memories, so what you learned today sticks tomorrow.
Kai: So naps help me study?
Nova: Yes! Your muscles repair themselves and your hormones reset too. Growing kids need extra sleep.

Skip sleep, and everything feels harder. (Kai yawns and rubs his eyes.)
Kai: Yaaawn... I can't focus.

Tip one: keep a steady bedtime.
Tip two: dim the lights and put screens away.
Nova: Sleep well, think better! Sweet dreams!
